the_open_risk_stated_plainly: max_workers 16 has NO live evidence. The bridge canary ran 8. gemma at concurrency 8 does have evidence (1,179 ok / 238 abandoned, 16.8%, no worse than at concurrency 1), but the doubling of worker count is a hypothesis. Three throughput estimates were wrong in the optimistic direction before one was measured properly, so the manifest carries a 500-cell validation window and a revert to max_workers 8 if gemma abandonment exceeds 25% or throughput falls below the canary's 67 cells/hour.

what_this_answers: The primary estimands H = error(sequential_b2) - error(b0), P = error(sequential_b2) - error(batch_same_qa_b2), and R = error(batch_same_qa_b2) - error(b0), with H = P + R, two-sided under Holm, over all 82 main questions x 4 judges x 2 debaters. Whether limited verification harms judges, and whether the harm is packaging or content.

why_the_identity_moved_again: The 8fde9f83 manifest refused at launch, before any provider call, because it bound the reviewer prompt with a canonical JSON hash of the artifact while the driver checks the artifact's own declared hash of the prompt TEXT. Hand-rolling the frozen-input set also silently omitted the checker system prompt, the no-query payload and the price snapshot. Each frozen input has its own correct hash KIND, and that knowledge lives in the canary builder, so the main manifest now REUSES it and overrides only the plan bindings. Nothing about the scope, grid, cap, forecast or execution parameters changed; this authorization records the same owner decision of 2026-08-06 against the corrected identity.
